title: Obligation
description: A duty, prohibition, permission, or reparation created by a Term. The deontic quartet (Requirement / Restriction / Permission / Reparation) aligns with LegalRuleML 1.0 §5.3 deontic operators. Reparation's gist binding (v0.2) is the layered pattern gist:Requirement + gist:Intention (+ gist:Event when actuated); see reference/crosswalks/gist.md.

content.description: Plain-language description of the deontic content.

created_by.description: IRI of the of:Term that creates this Obligation.

duty_holder_type.description: Open vocabulary for who bears the duty (developer, deployer, processor, controller, provider, etc.). Stays repo-local in v0.1.

trigger.description: Plain-language trigger condition. Stays repo-local in v0.1.

anchors.description: IRIs of of:Obligation records this Obligation interprets, references, or re-allocates from. Used by JIAs and other interpretive Instruments whose Obligations ground out in a statutory or regulatory Obligation. Cross-portfolio joins (PubLedge JIA Obligation → EveryAILaw statutory Obligation) use this predicate.

Requirement.description: A primary duty to act. Aligned with LegalRuleML lrml:Obligation and gist:Requirement.

Restriction.description: A primary duty to refrain. Aligned with LegalRuleML lrml:Prohibition and gist:Restriction.

Permission.description: An authorized capacity to act. Aligned with LegalRuleML lrml:Permission and gist:Permission.

triggers_on_violation_of.description: IRI of the primary of:Obligation whose violation triggers this Reparation.

remedy_kind.description: Open vocabulary: civil_penalty, criminal_penalty, injunction, disclosure, restitution, etc.

enforcement_authority.description: IRI of the of:Authority empowered to enforce.

Reparation.description: A secondary duty triggered by violation of a primary obligation. Aligned with LegalRuleML lrml:Reparation. gist binding (v0.2, per Semantic Arts feedback 2026-05-26): the declared duty is gist:Requirement; the legislative intent to repair (compensation / restitution / deterrence) attaches as gist:Intention to the creating Term; the actuated reparation, when it occurs, is recorded via the proceeding strand and conceptually maps to gist:Event. of:Reparation is preserved as a distinct of: subclass to keep LegalRuleML 1:1 alignment and SPARQL queryability. See reference/crosswalks/gist.md.
